title: GTEx v11 cis-eQTL significant variant-gene pairs (per-tissue)
description: GTEx Consortium release v11 cis-eQTL significant variant-gene pairs, one parquet file per tissue. 12 source columns: phenotype_id, variant_id (chr_pos_ref_alt_b38), start_distance, af, ma_samples, ma_count, pval_nominal, slope, slope_se, pval_nominal_threshold, min_pval_nominal, pval_beta. Built into a Hail Table keyed by (locus, alleles, gene_id) via spark.read.parquet → hl.Table.from_spark; see hvantk/skills/gtex_eqtl/SKILL.md. Used as eQTL input to hvantk/qtlcascade/ and variant annotation.
license: Public (summary statistics); dbGaP-controlled for individual-level data

files.description: Liver tissue v11 cis-eQTL significant variant-gene pairs (Apache Parquet). One file per tissue; the skill anchors against Liver as the smallest v11 tissue (~28 MB). Same schema across all 49 tissues.
